object.attr: stakeholder: STORE now limits attribute names so that a rules file can name them, which leaves out an empty name, a leading digit or hyphen, and the reserved rule names (handed over by STORE; review Q29). Replaces MELLON-EDIT-SRS-61.
object.description: If a new attribute name breaks MELLON-STORE-SRS-71 or MELLON-STORE-SRS-72, Mellon shall refuse to define the attribute.
